records.question: The parcel has not arrived. Can I see its shipping progress?
I need proof of payment for our finance department.
records.answer: Download your receipt from Orders → Billing documents.

approvedShelf.question: How do I return an item for a refund?
approvedShelf.answer: Unused items can be returned within 30 days. Request a return label from the order page.

approvedShelf.question: Where is my package and how do I track delivery?
approvedShelf.answer: Open your order confirmation and follow the tracking link. Tracking updates can take 24 hours.

approvedShelf.question: How do I reset a forgotten password?
approvedShelf.answer: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page. A reset link expires after 30 minutes.

approvedShelf.question: Can I get an invoice or receipt for my purchase?
approvedShelf.answer: Download your receipt from Orders → Billing documents.

approvedShelf.question: How do I cancel my subscription membership?
approvedShelf.answer: Go to Account → Membership → Cancel renewal. Access continues until the end of the paid period.
